messages.subject: Project Beacon - draft Heads of Terms
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel,

Draft Heads of Terms attached for your review. Key commercial points: EV GBP52m, debt-free/cash-free; equity consideration c.GBP47.5m; GBP43.5m cash at completion, GBP2m retention (18 months), GBP2m deferred/earn-out. Binding exclusivity to 31 October. Subject to contract throughout except the exclusivity, confidentiality and costs paragraphs.

Grateful for comments; happy to talk it through.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | +44 (0)20 7946 0815
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Project Beacon - draft Heads of Terms
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Looks right. One point - can we make the deferred consideration clearly an earn-out tied to EBITDA rather than a straight deferral? Margaret is keen the GBP2m is genuinely at risk if the FY26 numbers slip.

Otherwise happy for this to go to the sellers under cover of subject to contract.

Daniel
